episodes.title: The Angamaly Shift
episodes.break_rationale: Ashley attends her first Bethlehem Kudumba Unit prayer gathering in Angamaly, where her musical connection with Justin first ignites neighborhood curiosity.
episodes.recap_text: Following financial distress, Ashley and her family relocate to Angamaly. While adjusting to the neighborhood, she crosses paths with Justin, the charismatic choir coordinator.
episodes.teaser_next: Secret choir rehearsals and community encounters spark suspicions among the watchful Kudumba Unit elders.

episodes.title: Rhythms & Rumors
episodes.break_rationale: Justin confesses his genuine feelings on the eve of the parish feast just as neighborhood gossip threatens to expose their romance.
episodes.recap_text: Bonding over shared music, Ashley and Justin's secret romance blossoms despite contrasting backgrounds and community choir practice.
episodes.teaser_next: An unexpected student visa for Ireland arrives, threatening to tear Ashley and Justin apart.

episodes.title: The Ireland Dilemma
episodes.break_rationale: Emotional departure as Justin selflessly encourages Ashley to board her flight to Dublin, jumping forward to her sudden return.
episodes.recap_text: Torn between her family's hopes and an overseas education in Ireland, Ashley departs as Justin makes the agonizing choice to let her go.
episodes.teaser_next: Ashley returns to Kerala for a wedding, only to discover Justin standing across the parish church courtyard.

episodes.title: Harmonies of Bethlehem
episodes.break_rationale: The miniseries concludes with the joyful choir performance at the parish wedding, bringing Ashley and Justin's love story to a triumphant close.
episodes.recap_text: Ashley returns to Angamaly and confronts the feelings she left behind, leading to a tender and hilarious reunion with Justin.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the heartwarming Malayalam romantic comedy-drama miniseries.
